checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the bilinear pairing check e(LL, LR) == e(RL, [1]) in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl sound and correctly rejecting invalid proofs?

reachability.notes: Soundness of the pairing check is the ultimate cryptographic guarantee. Any implementation error in the pairing library would undermine all data availability.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl function (SG-015) and trace the bilinear pairing computation. 2. Review the pairing library implementation for BLS12-381 curve operations to ensure mathematical correctness. 3. Verify that the pairing equation e(LL, LR) == e(RL, [1]) is correctly computed with proper group element handling. 4. Construct test vectors with deliberately invalid KZG polynomial commitment relationships and verify they are rejected. 5. Test edge cases: zero commitments, identity elements, points not on curve, points in wrong subgroup. 6. Verify the pairing check maintains soundness guarantee of (1 - 1/q) rejection probability for invalid proofs. 7. Review for potential timing side-channels or implementation bugs in the pairing library that could weaken soundness.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0068, Trust Boundary: tb-005, Source Invariant: SG-015-INV-001, Source Assumption: asm-016. Critical boundary check for KZG proof verification soundness. Failure allows forged proofs to pass verification, breaking data availability guarantees.

checklist.title: Verify batch verifier correctly aggregates multiple cell proofs without introducing soundness vulnerabilities

reachability.notes: Soundness of the pairing check is the ultimate cryptographic guarantee. Any implementation error in the pairing library would undermine all data availability.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review actor-batch-verifier logic for how multiple cell proofs are combined before the pairing check. 2. Verify random linear combination weights (if used) are properly sampled and applied. 3. Test with batches containing mix of valid and invalid proofs - all should be rejected. 4. Verify that batching does not introduce cancellation attacks where invalid proofs can cancel each other. 5. Check that the trusted setup (actor-kzg-trusted-setup) parameters are correctly used in batch verification.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0068, Covered nodes: actor-batch-verifier, actor-kzg-trusted-setup. Supporting check for batch verification soundness.
